findings.title: Answer-card dialog clips on short landscape screens
findings.actual: At 740×320 CSS pixels the fixed dialog is 369.45px tall, starts at y=-24.72 and ends at y=344.72. Its overflow is visible rather than internally scrollable; the publication control also extends below the viewport.
findings.expected: All dialog content and controls remain reachable with internal scrolling on a short viewport.
findings.suggested_fix: Bound relevant dialog popups to the dynamic viewport and add internal scrolling; retest portrait, landscape and focus trapping.

findings.title: A late review lookup overrides a newer tab selection
findings.actual: Team was selected during a valid review lookup. When the read completed, History became selected and its panel appeared while keyboard focus remained on Team. The earlier draft-validation run encountered the same delayed switch.
findings.expected: Completing an older read must not override newer user navigation.
findings.suggested_fix: Choose the target tab when lookup begins and guard late/out-of-order completions with request/navigation identity; avoid an unconditional post-await tab switch.

findings.title: Lookup error feedback survives a successful retry and refers to transactions
findings.actual: A read-only lookup of the deliberately nonexistent 64-zero ID displayed a generic connection/transaction-hash warning. After the valid lookup completed and returned to History, that earlier alert remained until Dismiss was clicked.
findings.expected: Read-specific safe feedback should reconcile a failed lookup with a successful retry, without implying a wallet transaction occurred.
findings.suggested_fix: Track lookup errors separately from unresolved wallet outcomes; clear the appropriate read error on retry/success and use concise lookup wording without raw RPC data.

findings.title: An overlong answer title silently disables publication
findings.actual: A 101-character ASCII title disables Review publication, but no byte limit, counter, explanation, aria-describedby or invalid-state feedback is shown for that field.
findings.expected: Users can identify why publication is disabled and how to fix the title.
findings.suggested_fix: Show concise 100-byte UTF-8 limit feedback associated with the field; retain the validation guard.
